decisions.rationale: 0.5/first-down bonus favors Godwin's possession profile; close call

decisions.call: Re-check Kenneth Walker (foot) and Sam LaPorta (hip) vs inactives
SUPER_FLEX: start Daniel Jones over Sam Darnold
decisions.rationale: Darnold busted Wk1; Jones the upgrade if active

decisions.grade_note: Moore laid an egg (-0.1); benched Godwin (9.3) and Jameson (5.3) both beat him. Moore is boom/bust; the possession play (Godwin) is the steadier floor.

weeks.refreshed_note: Refreshed 9-23 with live data + injury research; waiver list expanded + SF correction (Darnold injured, Drew Lock starting) same night

lessons.text: Benched DJ Moore (crowded CHI room) scored 20.0, outscoring every started WR. Don't reflexively bench a talented WR for the possession-lean — ceiling matters. The Godwin-vs-Jameson possession lean was a wash (0.2 pts).

DJ Moore is boom/bust (20 then -0.1 back-to-back); the possession play (Godwin) is the steadier floor and better format fit — chase Moore's ceiling only when you NEED variance (underdog weeks). And: the #1 waiver claim has gone unused two straight weeks at 0-2 — stop sitting on it.
